lines.say: Can bad sleep stop you from building muscle?
In one study, healthy young adults skipped a single night of sleep.
The next day, their muscle building dropped by about eighteen percent.
Their cortisol, a stress hormone that breaks things down, went up.
Your body does a lot of its repair while you sleep.
Experts recommend at least seven hours a night for adults.
Dark room, cool room, same bedtime. Treat sleep like a set.
